agent_path.description: The path to the UNIX-domain socket for the agent. Overrides the default derived from SSH_AUTH_SOCK.

pinentry.description: Command to use for pinentry prompts when using USS. Defaults to gpg-agent.conf lookup or 'pinentry'.

port.description: The serial port device path to use with the TKey. If empty, auto-detection is attempted.

speed.description: Serial port speed in bits per second. Default is 62500. If empty, the default is used.

ssh_auth_sock.description: The path to the SSH agent socket. ssh(1) and ssh-add(1) use this variable to find the agent.

uss.description: If true, interactively ask for a User Supplied Secret (USS) to hash with the TKey identity.

uss_file.description: File path to read the User Supplied Secret from. Use '-' for stdin. Cannot be used with --uss.
